fact: The summative evaluation (October 2024) states that all conservatories and 152 health-unit registration posts were equipped and trained for eCRVS, that coverage of the digital system remains around 10 per cent, and that lack of hardware and internet in offices and posts leads to duplicated paper and electronic work.
title: Summative evaluation of the Strengthening Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) in Mozambique
